description: Repairs r-sort-3b/index-on-existing-nulls: UX1, UX2, UX3 and UX6 failed with 3022 because the data held real value duplicates (empty x6, a x6, N = 1 x6), so they did not isolate Null handling; IX7 WITH PRIMARY failed (3283) because X already had a primary key; the statements shared two tables, so a refusal could mask the next; after ALTER COLUMN K NOT NULL returned hr 0 nothing read K's Required state; and the walks of IX4 and UX6 walked indexes whose build had failed (0x800A0ED8, a storage-order walk). Fixture (General ACCDB). Base tables with no value duplicates, only Null-bearing repeats: BK(K, N) with K Null x3 and a, b, empty, c; BKN(K, N) with (Null,Null) x2, (Null,1) x2, (a,Null) x2, (empty,Null) x2, (a,1), (b,2); BN(K, N) with N Null x3 and 4, 5, 6, 7. Every statement below runs on its own fresh key-less copy (CREATE TABLE E_<tag> (K TEXT(20), N Long) then INSERT..SELECT from its base), in its own read/write open with dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors after it and an image kept after the close: unique (K), unique (K) IGNORE NULL, non-unique (K) DISALLOW NULL and (K) WITH PRIMARY, ADD CONSTRAINT PRIMARY KEY (K) on BK; unique (K, N) IGNORE NULL, non-unique (K, N) IGNORE NULL (walked after the build), non-unique (K, N) DISALLOW NULL, plain unique (K, N) on BKN; unique (N) IGNORE NULL on BN; and on BKN ALTER COLUMN K NOT NULL alone, then followed by unique (K, N) DISALLOW NULL and by (K) WITH PRIMARY. After each the refreshed field list (Required), the number of Null K rows, the row count and the refreshed index metadata are read; no index whose build was refused is walked.

CREATE TABLE BKN (K TEXT(20), N LONG)
INSERT INTO BKN (K, N) VALUES (Null, Null)
INSERT INTO BKN (K, N) VALUES (Null, Null)

INSERT INTO BKN (K, N) VALUES ('a', Null)
INSERT INTO BKN (K, N) VALUES ('', Null)
INSERT INTO BKN (K, N) VALUES ('', Null)

CREATE TABLE E_ukn (K TEXT(20), N LONG)
